description: Use this when the user asks for the tariff code, commodity code, customs code, HS code, HTS code, Harmonized System code or customs classification for a product, for example "what is the tariff code for a ceramic flower pot in the UK?", "HTS code for a lithium-ion battery" or "which heading covers cotton t-shirts for import into the US?". Pass a plain description of the product and country GB (United Kingdom) or US (United States). Returns candidate codes from the official schedule, each with its description, the headings above it and whether goods are declared under it, plus a notice that they are candidates and not a binding classification. Do not use it to classify goods with certainty, to give a binding customs ruling, to compute shipping or landed cost, or for countries other than GB and US.

country.description: Destination of the goods, whose import tariff to read: GB (United Kingdom Global Tariff) or US (Harmonized Tariff Schedule). The EU and other countries are not covered.

description.description: Plain description of the product: what it is, what it is made of, what it is used for. Or a code, to look that code up.

name: find_tariff_codes
title: Find an HS code, HTS or customs code
